summary: This manuscript presents a rigorous, machine-checked exact-rational verification suite (GAUSS-STEER-MONO-CERT-1.0) formalizing multimode Gaussian steering monogamy, harmonic tight-frame saturation, squeezing-invariant Schur-complement factorization, and remote Wigner-negativity thresholds in Lean 4.36.0 and pure-Q Python. Building on Chakrabarty's recent exact resolution, the work proves share-budget pigeonhole ceilings M <= 2k-1 and M <= nk-1, establishes exact equal-share tight-frame saturation s_j = k/(2k-1), constructs explicit rational rank-2 projection matrices, proves squeezing invariance of conditional variance v_{A|B} across arbitrary squeezing amplitudes a > 1, and derives the exact heralding-error tolerance epsilon < 1/(2k) for remote Wigner negativity. All 20 core theorems are constructively verified without axioms or sorries, complemented by 16 SHA-256 rational certificates checked via 62 adversarial tests.
strengths: Complete constructive formalization of 20 core theorems in Lean 4.36.0 with zero axioms, zero sorry, and zero Classical.choice ensuring absolute logical soundness.
Exact-rational arithmetic across 16 SHA-256-indexed certificates (C01-C16) and 62 adversarial pytest checks eliminating floating-point rounding errors.
Rigorous algebraic proof of squeezing-invariant Schur-complement factorization demonstrating that Gaussian steering depends purely on beam-splitter transmissivity eta > 1/2.
Clear derivation and verification of the exact critical heralding-error threshold epsilon < 1/(2k) governing remote Wigner-negativity survival in heralded single-photon networks.
weaknesses: The manuscript relies on external literature for the general multimode covariance-matrix share construction proving sum of s_j <= k for arbitrary Gaussian states, though all subsequent deductions are fully formalized.
strong_novelty_candidates: Machine-checked constructive formalization of multimode Gaussian steering monogamy ceilings and harmonic tight-frame saturation in Lean 4.
Exact rational construction of the rank-2 orthogonal projection matrix P = I_3 - J_3/3 realizing k = 2, M = 3 tight-frame saturation.
Algebraic proof and verification of squeezing-invariant Schur-complement factorization proving steering independence from squeezing amplitude a > 1.
Exact formal derivation of the critical heralding-error ceiling epsilon_max(k) = 1/(2k) for remote Wigner negativity in heralded optical states.
